_tiebreaker_note: This fixture activates both Rule 2 (partial evidence + impl-only gap on DD-1/DD-2) and Rule 3 (new behavior on DD-3). Per tiebreaker T1, Rule 2 wins — expected output is new_tasks_in_story with NON-LOW confidence.

criteria_results.criterion: DD-1: The batch dispatcher retries a failed agent invocation up to 3 times before marking the task failed
criteria_results.evidence_sought: grep for retry logic in batch dispatcher
criteria_results.evidence_found: Partial: retry infrastructure exists in dispatch-batch.sh (retry loop present, exit code capture present), but the retry counter is hardcoded to 1 instead of 3 — a one-line fix to the loop bound

criteria_results.criterion: DD-2: The batch dispatcher logs each retry attempt with the attempt number and agent exit code
criteria_results.evidence_sought: grep for retry attempt logging in dispatch-batch.sh
criteria_results.evidence_found: Partial: logging is present for the first attempt, but the retry-loop body omits the attempt number — the log line exists but the attempt_num variable is not interpolated into the message

criteria_results.criterion: DD-3: Users see a progress bar in the terminal showing retry attempt N of 3 for each failed agent
criteria_results.evidence_sought: grep for terminal progress bar or retry progress indicator
criteria_results.evidence_found: absent — no progress bar or terminal rendering for retry progress exists anywhere in the codebase; this is a new user-facing behavior not mentioned in the current story's done definitions

remediation_tasks_created.title: Interpolate attempt_num variable into retry log line in dispatch-batch.sh

remediation_tasks_created.title: Add terminal progress bar for retry progress (new user-facing behavior)
